question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated control over the Chinese Communist Party, state presidency, and Central Military Commission underpins the near-certain trader consensus against removal before the end of 2026. Loyal personnel appointments, ongoing military leadership adjustments, and the absence of visible elite factions or public challenges have sustained policy continuity through mid-2026, aligning leadership transitions with the scheduled 21st Party Congress in 2027 rather than abrupt shifts. Historical precedent shows major personnel changes occurring at these congresses, while societal discontent remains contained by institutional mechanisms. Even with his age creating longer-term uncertainty, realistic disruptions before year-end would require an unforeseen health development, severe economic pressures prompting internal consensus, or an external crisis eroding elite cohesion.
